assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single production inventory/world sprite for Magikitos, an original cozy top-down 16-bit woodland pixel-art adventure. Primary request: ONE old garden rake sized for a little woodland elf, warm polished wooden handle, worn muted iron comb with six short clearly separated tines, a small rough twine binding. Whole object shown diagonally resting on invisible ground, handle tip toward upper right, comb toward lower left; overhead three-quarter RPG perspective. Carefully defined pixel clusters, readable bold silhouette, restrained warm forest palette, light from upper left, rich but clean 16-bit shading, no blurry painterly texture. Composition: one centered isolated rake only, generous empty margin on every side, square high-resolution master for offline reduction to roughly 24 by 34 logical game pixels at 2x integrated resolution. Background: genuinely transparent PNG alpha. No grass, no terrain, no shadow, no floor, no border, no text, no watermark, no extra objects, no grid, no checkerboard drawn into the image.
